---
title: Valilla-ish DuckDB WASM
---

Use the latest version of DuckDB WASM to poke around in a Parquet file.

```{ojs}
duckdb = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@duckdb/duckdb-wasm/+esm");

async function instantiate(duckdb) {
  const CDN_BUNDLES = duckdb.getJsDelivrBundles(),
  bundle = await duckdb.selectBundle(CDN_BUNDLES), // Select a bundle based on browser checks
  worker_url = URL.createObjectURL(
    new Blob([ `importScripts("${bundle.mainWorker}");` ], {
      type: "text/javascript"
    })
  );

  // Instantiate the async version of DuckDB-WASM
  const worker = new Worker(worker_url),
  logger = new duckdb.ConsoleLogger("DEBUG"),
  db = new duckdb.AsyncDuckDB(logger, worker);

  await db.instantiate(bundle.mainModule, bundle.pthreadWorker);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(worker_url);

  return db;
}

DuckDB = await instantiate(duckdb);
db = await DuckDB.connect();
```

```{ojs}
version = {
    const v = db.query("SELECT version() AS Version").then((result) => {
        return result.get(0).Version;
    });
    return v;
};
```

The version of Duckdb is: `{ojs} version`.

Create a view of the parquet file `https://storage.googleapis.com/opencontext-parquet/oc_isamples_pqg.parquet`

```{ojs}
{
    db.query("CREATE VIEW node AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('https://storage.googleapis.com/opencontext-parquet/oc_isamples_pqg.parquet')");
}
```

`otypes` in the node list and their counts:
```{ojs}
Inputs.table(db.query("SELECT otype, COUNT(*) AS n FROM node GROUP BY otype;"));
```

A few latitude, longitude values:
```{ojs}
viewof ltlgtable = Inputs.table(
    db.query("SELECT pid, latitude, longitude FROM node WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL LIMIT 100;"), 
    {required: false, multiple: false});
```

```{ojs}
ltlgtable.pid;
```

This is ridiculously slow, find the subjects using the selected PID as the object:

```{ojs}
entry = {
    let related = null;
    if (ltlgtable) {
        const q = await db.prepare("select s,p from node where otype='_edge_' and list_contains(o, ?);");
        const params = [ltlgtable.pid, ];
        console.log(params);
        related = q.query(...params);
    }
    return related;
}
Inputs.table(entry);
```
